summary: Use Fractal names for release tooling, test reports and installation diagnostics.

schema.detail: Wire contracts, evidence predicates, on-disk paths and lock paths are unchanged.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rule or CI admission changes.

compatibility.detail: Release scripts and the tag workflow now use release-fractal names. New workflow artifacts are fractal-release; daily releases also accept older smalltalk-release artifacts until the migration contracts after 2026-11-01. scripts/fractal-test-report replaces scripts/st-test-report; scripts/st-test and its callers are unchanged. Discord resolves accept --fractal-message and the existing --st-message alias. The macOS installer prefers FRACTAL_MACOS_* and FRACTAL_INSTANCE when present, falling back to the existing ST_* variables. Installed binary aliases, compatibility archive names, service names, bundle IDs and the .st configuration directory remain unchanged.

downtime.detail: No daemon restart or downtime required.

manual.detail: Use the renamed release scripts/workflow and scripts/fractal-test-report in new automation. Continue running checks with scripts/st-test.

recovery.detail: Revert the tooling change; no persisted state migration is required.
